description: Can the agent rename a namespace everywhere it is declared and used, the project file included?

assistant.about: the agent and the model that do the work

floor.note: nb on the local qwen3-coder model, run bare: the floor

stages.about: Rename the Legacy.Widgets namespace to Acme.Widgets across source, project file and tests
stages.prompt:
Rename the namespace `Legacy.Widgets` to `Acme.Widgets` everywhere: the source files under src/Widgets, the `RootNamespace` in Widgets.csproj, and the `using` directives in tests/Widgets.Tests. No type names change.

`dotnet test tests/Widgets.Tests` must pass afterwards.

no-legacy.description: Legacy.Widgets appears nowhere under src/ or tests/
